title: Enterprise Software Company Equity Stake For Sale in Geneva, Switzerland
tagline: The business is developing an ERP-based technology platform for healthcare and professional-services groups. - It employs 10 people and is currently focused on product development and implementation readiness. - The platform is designed to support multi-entity organizations through standardized workflows and automated administrative controls. - The planned revenue model includes software licensing, implementation fees, managed back-office services, part-time CFO services, and fixed-price industry-specific packages. - The initial strategy is to deploy the platform within affiliated healthcare and accounting networks before offering it to external customers. - The technology includes a configurable code base, eight modules, 13 adaptations, and a capital-management engine. - The business plans to expand alongside its affiliated groups into Switzerland, Luxembourg, France, Belgium, Monaco, Spain, Portugal, and the United Arab Emirates. Future target markets include Canada, Brazil, and the United States. - The first third-party deployment and go-live activities are planned for next year. - The business is currently in the development phase and has not yet started generating revenue. - The business has a business registration certificate.
